$note: All fonts below are Google Fonts, SIL Open Font License. Devanagari/Kannada carry no true 'hand-painted signboard' option on Google Fonts -- see design/README.md for the gap this leaves and how each choice was made.

devanagari_display.rationale: Explicitly modeled on hand-painted Mumbai railway/hoarding signage -- heavy strokes, angular cuts, deliberately preserves brush-painted idiosyncrasy. Closest match on Google Fonts to the सफ़र-ए-UP / हॉर्न ओके प्लीज़ hero lettering. Single weight only (400) -- weight variation for hierarchy has to come from size, not boldness.
devanagari_display.alternate_rationale: More polished high-contrast serif (boutique menu-card register rather than roadside signage); use where a calmer, more classic Devanagari headline is wanted instead of the rougher Yatra One.

kannada_display.rationale: No Kannada Google Font matches Yatra One's hand-painted-signboard character (researched: Baloo Tamma 2, Anek Kannada, Hubballi are the closest options, all rounded/geometric/handwritten-casual rather than brush-painted). Baloo Tamma 2 chosen as the warmest and friendliest of the three, with a full weight range for hero-to-headline hierarchy that Yatra One can't offer.
kannada_display.known_gap: Flag for revisit once a closer signboard-style Kannada display face is found or commissioned.

latin_display.rationale: Warm, quirky, vintage-editorial serif with organic curves and optical-size/softness variable axes -- the closest Latin match to a hand-painted feel without going full script font.
latin_display.alternate_rationale: More refined/delicate transitional serif (poster type rather than signboard); single weight only.

body.note: Not one file -- Google Fonts ships these as separate per-script families designed to share metrics/style. Load all three and let per-script font-family fallback (or unicode-range) select the right one; do not assume a single 'Noto Sans' family covers all scripts.

scale.$note: Minimum sizes are deliberately larger than typical apps -- DalGains' audience spans ~13 to 80+ (CLAUDE.md). Values are mobile-first; desktop may scale up further, never down.

hero.weight: boldest available for the active script

caption.usage: Sparingly -- attribution, timestamps, fine print only, never a primary reading size
